from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
import os

engine = create_engine(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"])

with engine.connect() as conn:
    print("DATABASE:", conn.execute(text("SELECT current_database()")).scalar())
    print("ALEMBIC VERSION TABLE:", conn.execute(text("SELECT to_regclass('public.alembic_version')")).scalar())

    for table in ["users", "brand_settings", "refresh_sessions"]:
        exists = conn.execute(
            text("SELECT to_regclass(:name)"),
            {"name": "public." + table}
        ).scalar()
        print("TABLE", table, "=", exists)

    if conn.execute(text("SELECT to_regclass('public.alembic_version')")).scalar():
        versions = conn.execute(text("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version")).fetchall()
        print("APPLIED MIGRATIONS:", [row[0] for row in versions])

    if conn.execute(text("SELECT to_regclass('public.users')")).scalar():
        columns = conn.execute(text("""
            SELECT column_name
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE table_schema = 'public'
              AND table_name = 'users'
            ORDER BY ordinal_position
        """)).fetchall()
        print("USERS COLUMNS:", [row[0] for row in columns])
